headline: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) Earnings Beat Puts Valuation Back In Focus
summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) is back in focus after reporting fourth quarter and full year 2026 results that topped analyst expectations, along with fresh guidance, a higher dividend and a new share repurchase plan.
